Identify the insurer from the policy and clarify the issue concerning access to care under compulsory medical insurance. For questions about arranging care under compulsory medical insurance, a citizen may contact their medical insurance organisation. An offer of paid care does not in itself prove that there is no entitlement to free care. The reception office does not determine clinical urgency or treatment.
